fact: UNICEF says the Birth Registration Information Management System (BRIMS) on the DHIS2 platform has been implemented, with birth registration decentralized to all 15 counties and 58 centers.

The Liberian Observer reports a proposed concession agreement between Liberia's government and OeSD International GmbH for a digital civil registration system recording births, deaths and marriages, referred to a joint committee and not yet ratified.

Liberia has signed a US$52 million build-operate-transfer concession with Austrian State Printing Company (OSD) for the NIDCRVS digital civil registration and vital statistics system, which the House of Representatives referred to a joint committee on 16 October 2026 for a two-week review.
